text:
maria (sales): Quick sync on Helix probe POC — customer wants to validate 30B+ model variants and ensure private deployment fit. Can eng/ML confirm variant support and any quantization blockers?
ajay (solutions): Happy to coordinate. Which Helix variants are they testing? are we talking base vs. q4/q8 variants?
kim (eng): They mentioned Helix-30b, Helix-30b-quant-q4_0 and Helix-30b-kv-slim. q4_0 should be supported on our runtime but we need to check injection points for KV cache layout.
tori (ml-onboard): FYI Helix-30b has a nonstandard rotary embedding tweak — we have a shim but it increases mem by ~8%. For private deploys that could push them to a larger instance.
maria (sales): customer is on a regulated workflow — private deployment preferred. they asked for an estimate on monthly compute and a quick compatibility checklist to share with legal/security.
sam (security): We also need to know if any third-party telemetry or model call-backs are present. Does Helix pull remote weights or use any external endpoints?
kim (eng): No remote calls. model artifact is self-contained. The only runtime hook is our metrics emitter (opt-in for private), which we can disable.
ajay (solutions): Great — mary from the customer asked about latency SLOs for conversational throughput (8 concurrent users, 2 turns each, median 256 tokens). Can you ballpark?
tori (ml-onboard): On a rtx-a5000 equivalent, Helix-30b q4_0 single-instance steady-state with batching (batch size 8) should do ~40-60 tok/s. For 8 concurrent users with that RTT we recommend 2 instances behind a simple router to meet P99.
maria (sales): Pricing note: customer wants reserved capacity quote + on-prem license. I'll need a 3-tier cost estimate (dev POC low, prod small, prod scaled).
ajay (solutions): I'll draft numbers once we lock instance sizing. can engineering confirm memory footprint and whether slim-kv removes the extra 8%?
kim (eng): Slim-kv saves ~18% memory vs base but trades off some rerank quality. For q4_0 + slim-kv combined you'll fit on 48GB GPU with ~6GB headroom for 2K token context.
sam (security): Also add a note about KMS support — private deploy supports customer KMS/HSM. we'll need an inventory of dataflows for the security questionnaire.
maria (sales): I'll send the buyer a minimal preflight doc. can someone add a short compatibility checklist we can attach?
tori (ml-onboard): Checklist draft: 1) Model binary conforms to HF/torchscript artifact. 2) Tokenizer compat verified (we tested Helix tokenizer v2). 3) KV cache layout matches runtime expectation (shim validated). 4) Quantized variant tested at target sequence lengths (128/256/1024). 5) Memory & instance sizing confirmed for private. 6) KMS & telemetry opt-out confirmed.
ajay (solutions): Perfect. I'll format that and add pricing bins. maria, want me to CC legal for the contract template?
maria (sales): yes please. also loop in customer success for onboarding runbook.
kim (eng): One more tech note — if they need function/tool-calls we recommend using our gateway mode (adds ~5–8ms per token). Call out as optional.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: helix-shim-validation job started on staging (job_id: dj-8841).
tori (ml-onboard): I'll run the shim validation against the customer's sample prompts and post results here by EOD.
maria (sales): thanks team — I'll update the buyer after you post results. :thumbsup:
ajay (solutions): tagging follow-ups: @kim please confirm final memory numbers; @sam please prep the security questionnaire answers we can hand to their infosec.
